name: Billing Currency Type 1 Code
definition: Defines the type of currency to be used for the billing of a service.

ACCT.name: Account
ACCT.definition: Currency type used for the billing is the account currency.

STLM.name: Settlement
STLM.definition: Currency type used for the billing is the settlement currency.

PRCG.name: Pricing
PRCG.definition: Currency type used for the billing is the pricing currency.
